newsitem.title: FRANCE: France wants stronger role in South Africa economy.
newsitem.headline: France wants stronger role in South Africa economy.

text.p: Prime Minister Alain Juppe has asked a French business leader to prepare a study on how Paris could bolster its presence in the South African economy, an aide said on Tuesday.
Juppe has asked Jean-Francois Dehecq, chairman of the French pharmaceuticals firm Sanofi, to conduct the study, with recommendations due during the first four months of 1997, the aide said.
The report was commissioned just before a meeting in Paris on Tuesday between the French prime minister and South African Deputy President Thabo Mbeki.

Over lunch, Juppe and Mbeki discussed the humanitarian crisis in Zaire, bilateral ties, matters affecting the European Union and pending economic projects in the transport, telecommunications and defence sectors, the aide told Reuters after their meeting.
